commands.name: ExecuteRfcTerminalCascade
commands.response: RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 exact persisted executed state from the owning writer UnitOfWork; same command_id exact replay returns this original result before proof validation, owner preparation or current-state reads
steps: resolve exact LLD-01 command replay before owner preparation, proof validation or current-state reads; a successful replay returns the original committed RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 and never consumes another deliberate-action proof
inside one writer UnitOfWork reload the proposal and require it remains pending at the exact base proposal revision
revalidate that the triggering RFC remains in the exact proposal terminal_epoch_id with the exact current terminal status class/evidence captured by the proposal

recompute the complete current RFC/WFM scope using the accepted terminal binding and require exact equality with the proposal SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 fingerprint and persisted member authority

call LLD-05 RfcTerminalTaskParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade(uow,proposal_snapshot,execution_review.task_objective_exact_count,execution_review.task_objective_provider_fingerprint); STALE returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE and INDETERMINATE returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_FAILED, with no proof consumption or cascade mutation

call LLD-09 RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade(uow,proposal_snapshot,execution_review.communication_exact_count,execution_review.communication_provider_fingerprint) under the same rules

after both providers return READY reconstruct the exact current SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 from the pending proposal revision, identical persisted/current scope facts, empty stale reasons and the provider summaries certified equal by revalidation; require its digest exactly equals execution_review.preview_fingerprint or return RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE

only after all domain freshness checks pass call LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofProvider.validate_and_consume(uow,proof,'tickets.rfc.terminal_cascade.execute',DeliberateActionTargetV1{target_type:'rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal',target_id:proposal_id},base_revision,execution_review.preview_fingerprint); any action/target/revision/preview/session/expiry/single-use mismatch returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with no cascade mutation
insert the single command receipt before participant/domain rows can reference command_id; rollback removes it on participant failure

construct RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 with the outer command_id, actor binding and accepted execution_review.preview_fingerprint; it contains no proof/session secret and is not an authorization grant

invoke LLD-05 Task/Objective apply_terminal_cascade and LLD-09 Communication apply_terminal_cascade using the same UnitOfWork, already-revalidated proposal snapshot and the explicit command context; each participant requires the outer receipt, persists its exact provider-owned consequence/history/audit rows, and returns one bounded RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1

validate each participant apply summary has its exact expected domain, nonnegative exact result/audit counts and lowercase result_fingerprint; never copy the participant's complete result-ref/history set into LLD-03

if either participant apply or summary validation fails, roll back all database effects and keep the proposal pending; the consumed deliberate proof remains single-use per LLD-12 and the operator repeats the deliberate action before retry

transition the proposal pending->executed exactly once, append the bounded LLD-03 audit containing reviewed preview fingerprint plus the two participant apply summaries, persist the exact RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 command response and commit atomically
rules: the committed Task/Objective and Communication consequences must be exactly the consequences whose complete provider fingerprints/counts were reviewed; unchanged RFC/WFM scope alone is insufficient execution authority
provider revalidation is read-only, complete-set and same-UoW; no impact rows or provider-owned domain objects are copied into LLD-03

provider apply consequences/history/audit remain authoritative in LLD-05/LLD-09 and may have arbitrary valid cardinality; LLD-03 receives only fixed-shape RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 correlation summaries, so audit transport does not create a business cap
participant result_fingerprint is post-apply correlation evidence over complete provider-owned result/audit identities and is never substituted for the pre-apply provider revalidation authority
deliberate proof is friction evidence only and never authorizes an otherwise stale, ineligible or indeterminate business operation
proof validation/consumption occurs only after proposal, terminal, scope and both provider-impact freshness checks have succeeded
safe auto-accept cannot call this command
SRs and unrelated Local Tasks are never cascade targets
provider WFM source evidence is never rewritten
